review_list.case: For: Wikivoyage lists 1855 cob house with 3,000-rose garden ($7). Against: one counted source found (tourism board only has events there); a local heritage house.

review_list.case: For: Wikivoyage lists flying fox, biking, quads; tourism board partner. Against: an operator-run activity venue rather than a place; the beach (Cable Bay / Rotokura, see additions) is the place. Coordinates -41.20178, 173.41259 (OSM).

review_list.name: Motueka Sandspit
review_list.case: For: DOC area page names it, internationally recognised shorebird site. Against: one counted source, birding only, short visit, no tourism-board mention.

review_list.case: Reversed from reject to review: tourism board Motueka page names it ('popular destination year-round', 1926 enclosure) as a swim stop. Against: one source, a municipal pool-like venue. Coordinates not checked.

review_list.name: Janie Seddon Shipwreck
review_list.case: Addition (not in candidates): tourism board Motueka page 'iconic' last surviving military ship from both world wars, photographed from the shore. Against: seen from outside, ten-minute stop. OSM way 712699047 at -41.12364, 173.02584.

review_list.name: Brook Waimarama Sanctuary
review_list.case: Addition (not in candidates): tourism board names it twice (South Island's largest fenced sanctuary, tracks, guided and glow-worm tours, from NZ$15). Likely keep: permanent, half a day. Needs a Wikivoyage/DOC second source and a photo. Coordinates -41.31189, 173.29234 (OSM visitor centre).

review_list.name: Cable Bay (Rotokura)
review_list.case: Addition (not in candidates): tourism board beaches page calls it a hidden gem 20 min from Nelson; the Adventure Park and Walkway candidates sit here, with the 1876 cable memorial. A beach a real source names must not be lost. Coordinates -41.16221, 173.41271 (OSM Cable Bay Cafe) or -41.16024, 173.41259 (cable memorial).

review_list.name: Rabbit Island
review_list.case: Addition (not in candidates): tourism board beaches pages name Rabbit Island public park and beach (reached from Mapua by ferry or Richmond by road). Against: local recreation reserve; one source.

review_list.name: Whispering Falls

benchmark: Region benchmarks only partly apply (no Red Rocks etc.). Applicable checks pass: operator in place of a place rejected (Nelson Lakes Shuttles; Anatoki Salmon demoted); gateway village sent to review/flagged (Karamea flagged, Kohaihai and Wakefield kept out, Whanganui Inlet review); a civic/closed or memorial-type candidate (Tākaka Pioneers' Memorial) rejected; no once-a-week market kept. Ngārua Caves and Tata Beach were rescued from reject on counted tourism-board sources.
